versions.changelog: 1. Fixed: _meta.json version consistency with registry. 修复：_meta.json 版本号与 registry 一致。
1. Fixed: _meta.json version consistency with registry. 修复：_meta.json 版本号与 registry 一致。
1. Simplified: Cleanup instructions — close tab instead of logging out, suitable for personal use. 简化：清理建议改为关闭标签页，适合私人使用场景。
1. Added: Browser-session credential declaration with account verification and cleanup steps. 新增：浏览器会话凭据声明，含账户确认和使用后清理步骤。 2. Added: Data disclosure for read-mode context exposure. 新增：读取模式上下文暴露的数据披露。
1. Add Prerequisites section declaring openclaw browser profile requirement and security scope. 增加前置要求章节，明确声明 openclaw profile 依赖和安全范围说明。
1. Fix H1 title to match frontmatter name: Bilibili Messager | B站私信助手 (一致性修复). 2. No functional changes, SKILL.md content verified with browser DOM testing.
1. Add bilingual display name for ClawHub page title. 补全 ClawHub 页面双语展示名。
1. Add bilingual display name to ClawHub page title. 补全 ClawHub 页面双语展示名。

Clean up description: remove redundant trigger phrase line. 清理描述：删除单独的触发词行。
Enhance description with natural trigger phrases integrated. 扩充描述：将触发词自然融入 description.

1. Major restructure: add mode selector (send/reply/read), two-step verification for send/reply. 重大重构：增加模式选择（send/reply/read），发送/回复强制两步验证。
2. Rewrote ownership rules: use _Msg_[a-z0-9]+_\d+ as container selector, _MsgIsMe_ as sender indicator. 重写归属规则：用_Msg_[a-z0-9]+_\d+找容器，_MsgIsMe_判断发送方。
3. Fix class pattern: changed from hardcoded o7f0t to generic [a-z0-9]+ for session ID. 修复class模式：从写死的o7f0t改为通用的[a-z0-9]+匹配会话ID。
4. Add detailed FAQ for editor/button not found and DOM diagnosis. 增加常见问题：编辑器/按钮找不到、DOM结构诊断。
5. Remove incorrect de-identification requirements. 删除错误的去标识化要求。
1. Fix display name to proper format: Bilibili Messager | B站私信助手. 修复显示名称为正确格式。
Fix subprocess.run(shell=True) in record_audio.py for security compliance. 修复 record_audio.py 中 subprocess.run(shell=True) 调用，提升安全性。

Improve chat history guidance with more reliable sender detection based on message container signals instead of layout guesses. 优化聊天记录读取指导，改用消息容器信号判断发送方，减少对页面布局猜测的依赖。
Expand history coverage to include forwarded videos, shared cards, and images as first-class chat records. 扩展聊天记录范围，将转发视频、分享卡片和图片纳入正式聊天记录类型。
Refine the skill into a cleaner bilingual document with clearer execution principles and validation-backed notes. 将技能整理为更清晰的双语文档，并补充更明确的执行原则与基于实测的说明。
Refined skill wording and publishing readiness. 优化技能表述并整理为更适合发布的版本。
Optimized triggers for higher sensitivity: added bilibili dm, message, chat, history keywords. 优化激活词提高灵敏度：增加 bilibili dm、message、chat、history 等关键词。
新增：获取聊天记录功能（通过头像位置区分发送方，支持滚动加载历史记录）
